title: SYSRET Non-Canonical Return RIP (#GP in Ring 0)
description: sysretq returns execution to the address in %rcx. On x86_64 Intel processors, executing sysretq with a non-canonical RIP triggers a General Protection Fault (#GP) in Ring 0 with user stack/state active (CVE-2012-0217 class vulnerability).
impact: Local privilege escalation or kernel crash callable from unprivileged Ring 3 execution.
code_before:
movq 64(%rsp), %rcx
    addq $72, %rsp
    movq nexora_syscall_user_rsp(%rip), %rsp
    swapgs
    sysretq
code_after:
/* Security check: Return RIP must be in canonical user space (bits 47..63 == 0) */
    movq 64(%rsp), %rcx
    movq %rcx, %rax
    shrq $47, %rax
    jnz .Lsyscall_sysret_non_canonical

    /* ... restore registers ... */
    movq %gs:8, %rsp
    swapgs
    sysretq

.Lsyscall_sysret_non_canonical:
    movq %rsp, %rdi
    subq $8, %rsp
    call nexora_syscall_bad_rip_fault
    addq $8, %rsp
1:  hlt
    jmp 1b
verify_method: Unit test test_syscall_return_frame_rejects_non_canonical_rip in tests/test_syscall.c crafting frames with non-canonical RIPs and asserting safe fault path execution.

title: Shared Global Syscall Stack in .bss
description: Syscall entry and exit saved and restored the user stack pointer from singleton global memory (.bss scratch) rather than per-CPU local storage. Re-entrancy, nested interrupts, or concurrent multicore syscalls would clobber the user RSP.
impact: Stack corruption, return pointer clobbering, and kernel memory tampering under re-entrant or SMP execution.
code_before:
swapgs
    movq %rsp, nexora_syscall_user_rsp(%rip)
    movq nexora_syscall_kernel_rsp(%rip), %rsp
    /* ... */
    movq nexora_syscall_user_rsp(%rip), %rsp
    swapgs
    sysretq
code_after:
swapgs
    movq %rsp, %gs:8   /* per-CPU user_rsp */
    movq %gs:0, %rsp   /* per-CPU kernel_rsp */
    /* ... */
    movq %gs:8, %rsp
    swapgs
    sysretq
verify_method: Unit test test_percpu_stack_reentrancy_isolation in tests/test_syscall.c asserting nested syscall entries maintain independent user stack frames without clobbering.

title: ELF Loader Overlapping PT_LOAD Segments (W^X Bypass)
owasp_category: A01:2025 - Broken Access Control / A08:2025 - Integrity Failures
description: The ELF loader checked W^X permissions on each individual PT_LOAD segment, but did not prevent two segments from overlapping in virtual address space. An attacker could craft an ELF where an RX executable segment overlaps an RW writable segment, bypassing W^X protections.
impact: Arbitrary code injection into executable memory pages in loaded userspace processes.
verify_method: Unit test test_elf_loader_rejects_overlapping_segments with hand-built ELF having overlapping RX and RW headers, asserting NEXORA_EINVAL.

title: Unhandled Page Fault in uaccess Byte Copy
description: uaccess byte_copy raw-dereferenced user pointers. If a user pointer was in-bounds but mapped to an uncommitted or unmapped virtual page, touching it in kernel mode triggered a kernel page fault panic in Ring 0.
impact: Local Denial of Service / Kernel panic triggerable by unprivileged userspace passing invalid or unmapped addresses to system calls.
verify_method: Unit test test_uaccess_unmapped_page_fault_fixup passing unmapped in-range pointer and asserting -EFAULT return without panicking.

title: Kernel panic() on Malformed AI Object Input
description: AI tensor and work node creation called panic() when encountering malformed inputs such as null pointers, zero dimensions, rank overflow, or registry exhaustion. In userspace-exposed syscall paths, invalid input must return error codes rather than halting the system.
impact: Unprivileged Denial of Service: arbitrary processes could trigger a complete operating system halt.
verify_method: Fuzz testing suite test_malformed_ai_input_fuzz in tests/test_phase14.c evaluating null names, zero ranks, invalid dtypes, and arithmetic overflows.

title: Non-IRQ-Safe Trace Ring Spinlock Deadlock
description: nx_trace_emit acquired an atomic writer lock without disabling interrupts. If an interrupt service routine (ISR) fired on the same CPU while the lock was held and emitted a trace event, the ISR would spin forever waiting for the interrupted thread.
impact: Permanent CPU core freeze / deadlock whenever trace events were emitted from both thread and ISR contexts.
verify_method: Re-entrant mock ISR callback test test_trace_irq_safe in tests/test_phase17.c asserting IRQ disabled state during emission and non-hanging re-entrant emit.
verify_result: PASS (All C tests passed, manifest verified)

title: Unrestricted Capability Delegation in sys_cap_delegate
description: sys_cap_delegate permitted any process to lookup any target_pid and inject handles directly into that process's handle table without verifying whether the caller was a parent process or possessed an authorized IPC channel.
impact: Cross-process capability tampering, handle table exhaustion attacks, and unauthorized capability injection.
verify_method: Unit test test_capability_delegation_rejects_unrelated_process in tests/test_syscall.c asserting NEXORA_EPERM when delegating to an unrelated process.
